resources.string: Ukufunda bukhoma, ushintsho olulodwa oluqinisekisiwe ngesikhathi.
Ufuna umhlinzeki we-devfreq i-kernel edalula ngempela.
I-kernel yamanje ayivezi isixhumi esibonakalayo se-devfreq u-MaxManager angakwazi ukufunda nokubhala ngokuzethemba.
Isixhumi esibonakalayo esingaphezu kwesisodwa GPU esifaniswe ngokuzethemba okulinganayo. Ukulawula kuvaliwe ngakho-ke akukho okubhaliwe endaweni engalungile.

Ukufundwa kuvela ku-kernel devfreq node, hhayi ku-API yomthengisi. Yonke imibhalo iphinda ifundwe futhi iqhathaniswe; uma i-hardware yenqaba, inani langaphambilini liyabuyiselwa futhi utshelwe kanjalo - akukho lutho olubikwa njengelusetshenzisiwe ngaphandle kokufunda emuva okufanayo.
Ngayinye ihunyushwa ohlwini lwangempela lwe-OPP yale divayisi, bese iqinisekiswa ngemva kokubhalwa.
Isilingi esiphansi kanti umbusi usakhula ngendlela eguquguqukayo.
Ibanga eliphelele eliphephile, elinombusi onamandla ophethe.
Isitezi esiphezulu esibamba ngaphansi komthwalo; ukuvikela okushisayo kuhlala kusebenza.
Alukho uhlu lwe-OPP olubhalekayo olufakazelwe kule divayisi, ngakho-ke izinhloso zihlala zivaliwe.
Kuceliwe: khulula ukhiye bese ubuyela kusikali esiguqukayo
Okuvezwa lapha kuphela lokho umshayeli akushoyo futhi esingakuqinisekisa.
Imvamisa eyodwa eqondile ibanjiwe. Umbusi akasalinganisi GPU.
Inani elincane kanye nenani eliphakeme libekiwe; umbusi ulinganisa phakathi kwabo.
Alukho uhlu lwe-OPP olubhalekayo olufakazelwe, ngakho ububanzi nezilawuli zokukhiya kufihliwe.
Umshayeli uthi alukho uhlu lombusi kule divayisi.
Le divayisi iveza ithebula lemvamisa elisebenzisekayo
Izingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha zinqabile ushintsho futhi inani langaphambilini labuyiselwa
Ukusetshenziswa kwehlulekile futhi ukubuyisela akukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa
I-devfreq node ehlukile iyaphendula manje, ngakho-ke iseshini esesiteji isethwe kabusha kunokuba idluliselwe kwenye indawo.
Okuthile ngaphandle kwalesi sikrini kuguqule amanani, ngakho-ke isifinyezo esiqinisekiswe ngaphambilini asisanikezwa ukuthi silondolozwe.
Funda amanani abukhoma ngezansi; akukho okunye okuzanywayo ukusuka lapha.
Umbhalo ongabuyeli emuva njengoba uceliwe uthathwa njengesehluleki, hhayi njengempumelelo.
Amanani afundiwe manje afana nalokho okuceliwe.
Isicelo esesiteji sihoxisiwe, ngakho-ke akukho lutho olulindile ukufakwa.
Inani elincane kanye nenani eliphakeme libekiwe; umbusi ulinganisa phakathi kwabo.
Kuhlelwa umbusi ohlukile; iqala ukusebenza nesicelo sonke.
Ukubamba ifrikhwensi eyodwa akufakazelwanga kule divayisi.
Ukukhipha isikhiya somthengisi akutholakali kule divayisi.
Ububanzi budinga kokubili ubuncane kanye nobuningi.
Ububanzi bamanje abukwazi ukufundwa, ngakho ushintsho alukwazanga ukuhlehliswa.
Iyunithi yefrikhwensi ayikwazi ukuxazululwa ngokuzethemba, ngakho-ke akukho ukubhala okuzanywayo.
Abahlinzeki abangaphezu koyedwa GPU bafanisiwe; akukho ukubhala okuzanywayo.
Umhlinzeki GPU inguquko ebeseyimelene naye akasekho.
Ibuyisela ububanzi kanye nombusi kumanani le divayisi eyayinawo ngenkathi kuvulwa isikrini. Akukho okubhaliwe ngenkathi sezivele zifana - lena indlela yokubuya kunoma ubani oguqule okuthile.
